text:
jamie_support: FYI customer acme-prod seeing intermittent 500s + cross-region spikes. They report requests start in us-west then a hedged retry goes to eu-west. Also noticed a billing spike. Can someone take a look?

marta_engineer: Can you paste the client config and a short log sample? hedged + tight timeouts are my first guess.

jamie_support: Minimal repro from their Node SDK:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ region: 'us-west-2', retry: { hedgedRequests: true, hedgeDelayMs: 80, baseBackoffMs: 100 }, timeoutMs: 750 });
await client.generate(...)
```
sample logs:
```txt
2026-03-01T12:00:00Z - req-id=abc start region=us-west
2026-03-01T12:00:00Z - timeout after 750ms -> retrying
2026-03-01T12:00:00Z - hedged request -> routed region=eu-west req-id=def
2026-03-01T12:00:01Z - original responded 200
```

marta_engineer: OK so original succeeded after the hedge already fired -> client issued two requests and got two successes. That explains the doubled token usage. Do we have router/health logs for that window?

lucas_sre: digging into router logs now. I can see short-lived 5xxs from a subset of us-west hosts around 12:00:00. Health checks briefly marked ~20% of pool unhealthy -> router started preferring eu-west for new hedged routes. Looks like hedge policy allowed cross-region hedges.

region-router-bot: route-event: 1932102469 - failover-triggered region us-west -> eu-west reason=partial-health-failure affected-tenants=acme-prod

dylan_sdk: Two quick mitigations: 1) set hedgedRequests=false for write-heavy or billing-sensitive flows, or 2) increase hedgeDelayMs beyond typical timeout so hedges only fire when original is truly slow. Also recommend customers include an idempotency key header for writes to avoid duplicate charges.

jamie_support: Customer is on embeddings + generation writes, they reported duplicate embedding charges. Do we have any server-side dedupe?

marta_engineer: We don't automatically dedupe generation/embedding requests. We support an X-Idempotency-Key header for endpoints that are idempotent, but most generation requests are not deduped server-side today. Ops should review billing hits.

lucas_sre: I'll correlate billing records with request IDs and timestamps. Quick customer mitigation: set hedgeDelayMs=200 and disable hedgedRequests for high-cost endpoints.

jamie_support: Sent that config suggestion to the customer and asked them to try disabling hedgedRequests for a day. Also opened billing ticket for duplicate charges.

dylan_sdk: I'll add a small SDK warning and docs update: if hedgedRequests=true and timeoutMs <= hedgeDelayMs, warn about potential duplicate requests and billing. Will push a patch. :white_check_mark:

marta_engineer: On infra side, we'll change router policy: avoid cross-region hedges unless no healthy nodes in origin region. Plan a canary rollout next week.

lucas_sre: Canary scheduled for eng-staging tomorrow morning, will monitor health-check flaps and hedged routing. Ping me if you need exact log slices.

jamie_support: Thanks all — I'll update the customer thread when they confirm.

jamie_support: UPDATE (customer): disabling hedgedRequests + hedgeDelayMs=200 stopped the duplicate charges and latency spikes. They re-enabled hedges with longer delays and are happy for now.

marta_engineer: Great, we'll still follow up with the router change and SDK warning.

dylan_sdk: Adding an integration test to catch cross-region hedges in CI.

jamie_support: Closing loop with customer. Thanks! :pray:
